Junior Full-Stack Developer (TypeScript, Python, LLMs)
Fes, Morocco · nour.elidrissi@example.com · https://github.com/example-nour

PROFILE
Recent Computer Science graduate with a 6-month full-stack internship and several shipped side projects that use LLM APIs.

EXPERIENCE
Full-Stack Developer Intern, Medina Pay (fintech startup), Fes · Feb 2025 – Jul 2025

- Wrote Jest unit tests for the payment-reconciliation module and fixed 30+ bugs from the backlog.

JobFeed API (Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL) · 2024

Portfolio site (Next.js, Tailwind CSS) · 2024

SKILLS
Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, SQL

jobText:
Backend Engineer (Python)
Lumenrail · Remote (work from anywhere) · Full-time

Lumenrail builds route-planning APIs for regional freight companies. We are 14 people across 9 countries.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain the Python services behind our public routing API.
- Design PostgreSQL schemas and keep queries fast.
- Ship features with the product team and review each other's code.

Requirements
- 3+ years of professional backend development experience.
- Strong Python.
- Experience with FastAPI or Django.
- Solid PostgreSQL skills.
- Experience running services in Docker on AWS.
- Kubernetes in production.

Nice to have
- Redis or Celery.
- You have built something with an LLM API.

Location and hours
Work from anywhere in the world. We need at least 4 hours of overlap with US Pacific time (9am–1pm PT) every weekday.
